page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 64 physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance in specific areas, particularly in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, which reached 269.5 GB/sec, and large-block read-only memory bandwidth at 209.21 GB/sec. Passmark database operations and extended instructions tests also registered strong results. Conversely, the instance exhibits weaker performance in LLM text generation, with text generation speeds for a 7B model limited to 8.69 tokens/sec. Other metrics, such as static web serving throughput at 32.47 GB/sec and Redis SET operations at 57.01 million operations per second, fall within the average performance tier.

From a resource allocation perspective, the dedicated core model ensures consistent CPU performance without virtualization-induced noisy neighbor issues. However, the complete absence of local storage means users must factor in the latency and cost of network-attached storage. This hardware profile is optimized for compute-heavy workloads, multi-threaded data decompression, software compilation, and database operations, while being less optimal for memory-intensive applications or large-scale LLM text generation.
